text.en: Atlas astronomy engine fixture design study

note.en: SIM: circular coplanar orbits with synthetic zero phase; approximate fixed-J2000 sky; qualitative twinkle; comet E steps and anti-solar tail. No dated ephemeris or visibility forecast. All display spacing and overview radii are designed. Catalogue data are separately distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
note.zh: 模拟：共面圆轨道、零相位教学排列；固定J2000近似天空；定性闪烁；彗星E步与反太阳尾。非当天星历或可见性预报。总览半径和间隔为设计值。星表独立以CC BY-SA 4.0发布。
